title: After Union Budget 2024-25: Evaluating Progress and Addressing Gaps in Integrated WASH Financing
description: An important comparative point in relation to the Union Budget for 2024-25 is with regard to the evaluation as to how effectively it builds on the interim budget’s preliminary projections on ‘Viksit Bharat’ by 2047.
